name: Kenaz
title: Caleb's brother and ancestor of Othniel
summary: Kenaz is known in the Bible as a descendant of Esau through Eliphaz, and as the father of Othniel, Israel's first judge. He belonged to the Kenizzites, a clan that was incorporated into the tribe of Judah. Through his son Othniel, Kenaz's family played an important role in the conquest and settlement of the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Kenaz mentioned as an ancestor
keyEvents.description: Kenaz is mentioned in the genealogies as the brother of Caleb and the father of Othniel, the first judge of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Kenizzites in Esau's lineage
keyEvents.description: Kenez is listed as a chief among Esau's descendants in Edom, which shows the clan's origin.

keyEvents.title: Othniel's Conquest of Kirjath-Sepher
keyEvents.description: Kenez's son Othniel conquered the city of Kirjath-Sepher (Debir) and received Caleb's daughter, Achsah, as his wife as a reward.

keyEvents.title: Othniel as Israel's First Judge
keyEvents.description: Kenez's son Othniel was raised up by the Lord as Israel's first judge and delivered the people from the oppression of Cushan-Rishathaim.

keyEvents.title: Kenez in the Genealogies of Judah
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Kenez and his descendants are mentioned as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, confirming the clan's integration into Israel.

keyEvents.title: Caleb as a Kenizzite
keyEvents.description: Caleb is called a 'Kenizzite,' which links him directly to Kenez and shows that the Kenizzites were an accepted part of the tribe of Judah.
